preservation: Retain the supplied ZIP and every extracted file unchanged. Run tests in disposable directories. Do not run nodewind.py, whose top-level body launches a calculation. Inspected imports used by atlas, sweep and trace have no network, deletion or subprocess operations; the CLI writers append sweep JSONL or overwrite explicitly supplied seed/trace output paths.
tooling_regressions: Resume keys collide when N or grid changes
Error rows are treated as completed on resume
Truncated final JSONL records are not repaired before append
Supporting-line crossing outside the segment is returned as an event
Secant iteration may leave its supplied bracket
Iteration exhaustion relaxes requested event tolerance to 1e-5
Changing N in seed metadata does not change the tracer default
Returned per-point solve count omits earlier bracket and secant evaluations
candidate_scope: Deduplicate the seven supplied trace rows by their full five-knob coordinates, giving six distinct states. Evaluate both separately coded native complex Hamiltonians at those supplied coordinates, then refine p, q and the upper node with the published guarded Newton solver. Use N4 and N6 with matching cutoff padding 1e-6. These are bounded sampled checks, not continuous identity certificates.
event_refinement: At each supplied state, preserve strain, angle, twist and tunnelling scale. Search for a geometric event only within the fixed D interval supplied_D plus/minus 0.1 meV, with a scalar bracketed Brent solver. Every node refinement is constrained to the original supplied node's plus/minus 0.02 fractional-coordinate box. Require successful guarded roots, interior segment parameter, unchanged periodic image lift and opposite endpoint offsets. Retain failures; no range, seed or tolerance changes to force recovery.
recording: Store source hashes, input references, all guarded solver histories, event brackets and evaluation histories, matrix/spectrum comparisons, actual basis index lists and hashes, wall time from run start and total solver eigensolves. Recompute original demo stored-coordinate gaps and offsets. Report cutoff dependence and basis membership changes separately from implementation agreement.
scope: Exploratory partner-tool review and sampled event-candidate verification. A successful result does not certify complete inventories, continuous identity in varying strain/angle, a continuous event surface, charge transport, a full braid, Euler-class change, experimental feasibility or infinite-cutoff accuracy. P is a dimensionless tunnelling scale; D remains the opposite layer potential amplitude.
